deployments.title:
test: Set stop_signal to SIGTERM

The official nginx images set STOPSIGNAL to SIGQUIT which dumps core.
Set it to SIGTERM to avoid dumping core on e2e tests.

Signed-off-by: Ricardo Branco <rbranco@suse.de>
